## COMMAND INFO flags: which commands are refused under OOM (denyoom flag)
set: write denyoom 1 1 1 @write
get: readonly fast 1 1 1 @read
del: write 1 -1 1 @keyspace @write
unlink: write fast 1 -1 1 @keyspace
expire: write fast 1 1 1 @keyspace
incr: write denyoom fast 1 1 1
mget: readonly fast 1 -1 1 @read
hset: write denyoom fast 1 1 1
eval: noscript stale skip_monitor no_mandatory_keys movablekeys script_runner

$ redis-cli -p 7206 ACL SETUSER cacheapp on >test-only-secret ~app:* +@read +@write +@connection -@dangerous
OK
$ redis-cli -p 7206 ACL GETUSER cacheapp
flags
on

-@all +@read +@write +@connection -@dangerous
keys
~app:*
channels

selectors

AUTH cacheapp test-only-secret -> +OK
SET app:1 v -> +OK
GET app:1 -> $1
GET other:1 -> -NOPERM No permissions to access a key

CONFIG GET maxmemory -> -NOPERM User cacheapp has no permissions to run the 'config|get' command

DEL app:1 -> :1

## SCRIPTS USED (source)
----- fillF.py -----
import sys, socket
# usage: fill.py prefix n valuebytes [ttl]  -> pipelines SET prefix:i value (EX ttl)
prefix, n, vb = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
ttl = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 0
s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 7206))
def cmd(*a):
    b = b"*%d\r\n" % len(a)
    for x in a:
        x = x if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x).encode()
        b += b"$%d\r\n%s\r\n" % (len(x), x)
    return b
val = b"v" * vb
B = 1000
for start in range(0, n, B):
    buf = b"".join(cmd("SET", f"{prefix}:{i}", val, *( ("EX", ttl) if ttl else () )) for i in range(start, min(n, start + B)))
    s.sendall(buf)
    need = min(B, n - start); got = 0
    while got < need:
        got += s.recv(65536).count(b"+OK\r\n")
----- zipf.py -----
# Cache-aside traffic with Zipf-like popularity against a real Redis (port 7206).
# N items, P(rank k) ~ 1/k^alpha. 200-byte values. Requests pipelined in batches of 200
# (GETs, then SET for each miss). First WARM requests warm the cache; stats are reset; MEAS requests measured.
import sys, socket, random, bisect, itertools, subprocess, re
N=100_000; WARM=300_000; MEAS=300_000; B=200; VB=200
RC="/opt/homebrew/opt/redis/bin/redis-cli"
def cli(*a): return subprocess.run([RC,"-p","7206",*a],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
def info(sec):
    d={}
    for l in cli("INFO",sec).splitlines():
        if ":" in l:
            k,v=l.split(":",1); d[k]=v
    return d
s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",7206)); f=s.makefile("rb")
def cmd(*a):
    b=b"*%d\r\n"%len(a)
    for x in a:
        x=x if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x).encode()
        b+=b"$%d\r\n%s\r\n"%(len(x),x)
    return b
def readreply():
    l=f.readline()
    if l[:1]==b"$":
        n=int(l[1:]); 
        if n<0: return None
        d=f.read(n+2); return d[:-2]
    return l[1:-2]
val=b"v"*VB
def run(alpha, policy, frac, seed=1):
    cli("FLUSHALL"); cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory","0"); cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory-policy",policy)
    base=int(info("memory")["used_memory"])
    cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory",str(int(base+frac*N*271)))
    w=[1/(k**alpha) for k in range(1,N+1)]; cum=list(itertools.accumulate(w)); tot=cum[-1]
    rnd=random.Random(seed)
    # popularity rank -> key id scrambled so that rank is not correlated with key insertion order
    perm=list(range(N)); rnd.shuffle(perm)
    def phase(n):
        done=0
        while done<n:
            ks=[perm[bisect.bisect_left(cum,rnd.random()*tot)] for _ in range(min(B,n-done))]
            s.sendall(b"".join(cmd("GET",f"p:{k}") for k in ks))
            miss=[k for k in ks if readreply() is None]
            if miss:
                s.sendall(b"".join(cmd("SET",f"p:{k}",val) for k in miss))
                for _ in miss: readreply()
            done+=len(ks)
    phase(WARM); cli("CONFIG","RESETSTAT"); phase(MEAS)
    st=info("stats"); h=int(st["keyspace_hits"]); m=int(st["keyspace_misses"])
    db=int(cli("DBSIZE")); ideal=sum(w[:db])/tot   # best a static cache of the same number of items could do
    return h/(h+m), ideal, int(st["evicted_keys"]), db, int(info("memory")["used_memory"])
if __name__=="__main__":
    alphas=[float(x) for x in sys.argv[1].split(",")]; pols=sys.argv[2].split(","); fracs=[float(x) for x in sys.argv[3].split(",")]
    print(f"N={N} items, warm={WARM}, measured={MEAS} requests, 200-byte values, maxmemory=baseline+frac*N*271 bytes")
    print("alpha policy  cache_frac  measured_hit_ratio  static_optimal_for_dbsize  evicted_keys(measured phase)  dbsize  used_memory")
    for a in alphas:
        for p in pols:
            for fr in fracs:
                hr,ideal,ev,db,um=run(a,p,fr)
                print(f"{a:.1f} {p:12s} {fr:6.2f} {hr:8.4f} {ideal:8.4f} {ev:8d} {db:7d} {um}",flush=True)
----- zipf_slow.py -----
# Same as zipf.py but paced at ~5000 requests/s so that cache turnover takes many seconds (longer than Redis's 1-second LRU clock).
import time, sys, zipf
from zipf import *
RATE=5000
def run_slow(alpha, policy, frac, warm_s, meas_s, seed=1):
    cli("FLUSHALL"); cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory","0"); cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory-policy",policy)
    base=int(info("memory")["used_memory"]); cli("CONFIG","SET","maxmemory",str(int(base+frac*N*271)))
    w=[1/(k**alpha) for k in range(1,N+1)]; cum=list(itertools.accumulate(w)); tot=cum[-1]
    rnd=random.Random(seed); perm=list(range(N)); rnd.shuffle(perm)
    def phase(seconds):
        t0=time.time(); n=0
        while time.time()-t0<seconds:
            ks=[perm[bisect.bisect_left(cum,rnd.random()*tot)] for _ in range(B)]
            s.sendall(b"".join(cmd("GET",f"p:{k}") for k in ks))
            miss=[k for k in ks if readreply() is None]
            if miss:
                s.sendall(b"".join(cmd("SET",f"p:{k}",val) for k in miss))
                for _ in miss: readreply()
            n+=B; target=t0+n/RATE; d=target-time.time()
            if d>0: time.sleep(d)
        return n
    phase(warm_s); cli("CONFIG","RESETSTAT"); n=phase(meas_s)
    st=info("stats"); h=int(st["keyspace_hits"]); m=int(st["keyspace_misses"])
    db=int(cli("DBSIZE")); return h/(h+m), sum(w[:db])/tot, int(st["evicted_keys"]), db, n
print(f"paced at {RATE} req/s, N={N}, alpha=1.0, cache ~15% of items, warm 60 s, measured 60 s")
for p in sys.argv[1].split(","):
    hr,ideal,ev,db,n=run_slow(1.0,p,0.15,60,60)
    print(f"{p:14s} hit_ratio={hr:.4f} static_optimal_for_dbsize={ideal:.4f} evicted={ev} dbsize={db} requests_measured={n}",flush=True)
----- metastable.py -----
# Illustrative model (no Redis involved): a cache in front of a database that can serve CAP queries/s.
# A cold cache after a flush; requests that miss go to the database queue (FIFO, deterministic service 1/CAP s each).
# A client abandons a request after TIMEOUT s but the database still performs the queued work (no cancellation).
# A cache entry is only filled if the database answered within TIMEOUT (the application fills the cache from a successful read).
import random, bisect, itertools, sys
N=100_000; ALPHA=1.0; R=2000; CAP=300; TIMEOUT=1.0; DT=0.01
def run(variant, seed=7, warm_s=120, run_s=300, ramp=None):
    rnd=random.Random(seed)
    w=[1/(k**ALPHA) for k in range(1,N+1)]; cum=list(itertools.accumulate(w)); tot=cum[-1]
    cache=set(); db_free_at=0.0; t=0.0
    # warm phase: database effectively unlimited
    for _ in range(int(warm_s*R)):
        cache.add(bisect.bisect_left(cum,rnd.random()*tot))
    warm_hit=sum(w[k] for k in cache)/tot
    cache.clear()   # trigger: cache lost (restart / flush)
    out=[]; t=0.0; nsec=0; hits=miss=ok_db=timeouts=shed=attempts_db=0; busy=0.0
    nxt=1.0; inflight_fill=[]  # (done_time,key)
    n_total=int(run_s/DT)
    for step in range(n_total):
        t=step*DT
        # complete fills
        while inflight_fill and inflight_fill[0][0]<=t:
            cache.add(inflight_fill.pop(0)[1])
        lam=R*DT
        # arrivals: Poisson via binomial approx
        n=int(lam)+(1 if rnd.random()<lam-int(lam) else 0)
        admit = 1.0 if ramp is None else min(1.0, ramp(t))
        for _ in range(n):
            if rnd.random()>admit: continue   # traffic not yet routed to this app (gradual ramp)
            k=bisect.bisect_left(cum,rnd.random()*tot)
            if k in cache: hits+=1; continue
            miss+=1
            tries=2 if variant=="retry" else 1
            for a in range(tries):
                if variant=="shed":
                    queue_wait=max(0.0,db_free_at-t)
                    if queue_wait>TIMEOUT*0.5: shed+=1; break   # reject misses we could not answer in time
                start=max(t,db_free_at); done=start+1.0/CAP
                if done-t>20: break   # database connection pool full: query refused
                db_free_at=done; attempts_db+=1; busy+=1.0/CAP
                if done-t<=TIMEOUT:
                    ok_db+=1; inflight_fill.append((done,k)); inflight_fill.sort(); break
                else: timeouts+=1
        if t>=nxt:
            tot_req=hits+miss
            out.append((int(nxt),hits/max(1,tot_req),attempts_db,max(0.0,db_free_at-t)))
            hits=miss=attempts_db=0; nxt+=1
    return warm_hit,out
if __name__=="__main__":
    print(f"N={N} alpha={ALPHA} offered load={R}/s DB capacity={CAP}/s timeout={TIMEOUT}s")
    for v in sys.argv[1].split(","):
        base,_,rp=v.partition("+")
        wh,out=run(base, ramp=(lambda t: 0.05+t/150.0) if rp=="ramp" else None)
        print(f"\nvariant={v}: warm hit ratio before loss = {wh:.3f}; steady DB load when warm = {(1-wh)*R:.0f}/s")
        print(" t(s)  hit_ratio  db_queries_that_second  db_queue_delay_s")
        for s,h,a,q in out:
            if s in (1,2,3,5,10,20,30,60,90,120,150,180,240,300): print(f" {s:4d}   {h:6.3f}   {a:6d}   {q:6.2f}")
----- arith.py -----
import math, itertools
def zipf_p(N,a):
    w=[1/(k**a) for k in range(1,N+1)]; t=sum(w); return [x/t for x in w]
def static_opt(p,C): return sum(p[:C])
def che_lru(p,C):
    # Che approximation: find tc with sum(1-exp(-p_i tc)) = C ; hit = sum p_i (1-exp(-p_i tc))
    lo,hi=0.0,1e12
    for _ in range(200):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        occ=sum(1-math.exp(-pi*mid) for pi in p)
        if occ<C: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    tc=(lo+hi)/2
    return sum(pi*(1-math.exp(-pi*tc)) for pi in p), tc
print("== Zipf alpha=1.0, N=100000, C=15048 (the paced run): static optimal, Che-LRU")
p=zipf_p(100000,1.0)
h,tc=che_lru(p,15048)
print(f"static optimal top-C = {static_opt(p,15048):.4f}; Che LRU = {h:.4f}; characteristic time tc = {tc:.1f} requests; at 5000 req/s = {tc/5000:.2f} s; at 60000 req/s = {tc/60000:.2f} s")
print("== N=100000 alpha=1.0, other sizes (Che LRU vs static optimal)")
for C in (1172,2218,5177,10086,19910):
    h,tc=che_lru(p,C); print(f"C={C:6d} ({C/100000:.3%}) static={static_opt(p,C):.4f} CheLRU={h:.4f}  tc={tc:,.0f} req")
print("== Static-optimal hit ratio of caching the top fraction, N=1,000,000 items")
for a in (0.8,1.0,1.2):
    p=zipf_p(1_000_000,a)
    print("alpha",a,{f"{f:.0%}":round(static_opt(p,int(f*1_000_000)),3) for f in (0.001,0.01,0.05,0.10,0.20,0.50)})
print("== Database load multiplier when the cache is lost: 1/(1-h)")
for h in (0.5,0.8,0.9,0.95,0.99,0.999): print(f"h={h}: x{1/(1-h):.0f}  | misses per 1000 requests {1000*(1-h):.0f}")
print("== Largest offered load a database of capacity C survives with a warm cache of hit ratio h: R_max = C/(1-h)")
for C in (300,): 
    for h in (0.8,0.9,0.95,0.99): print(f"C={C} h={h}: R_max={C/(1-h):.0f}/s; with cold cache only R<={C}/s")
print("== Retries multiply: 3 layers each making 3 retries (4 attempts) -> 4^3 =",4**3)
print("== Little's law connections: L = lambda*W; 40 app instances x 20 pool = ",40*20, "connections;  1000 req/s per instance x 0.5 ms Redis time = ",1000*0.0005,"concurrent")
print("== Bandwidth: 50,000 GET/s x 2 KiB =", 50000*2048/1e6,"MB/s =", 50000*2048*8/1e9,"Gbit/s")
print("== Memory sizing: product catalogue 2,000,000 items x (3 KiB value + 64 B overhead + 30 B key) =", 2_000_000*(3072+64+30)/2**30,"GiB; hot 20% only =",0.2*2_000_000*(3072+64+30)/2**30,"GiB")
print("== Warm-up lower bound: fill 100,000 items from a database with 100 spare qps =", 100000/100,"s =",100000/100/60,"min")

import socket, time, threading
def conn():
    s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",7206)); s.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY,1); return s
def get_lat(s):
    t=time.perf_counter(); s.sendall(b"*2\r\n$3\r\nGET\r\n$3\r\nc:1\r\n"); d=b""
    while not d.endswith(b"\r\n") or d.count(b"\r\n")<2: d+=s.recv(65536)
    return (time.perf_counter()-t)*1000
probe=conn(); base=[get_lat(probe) for _ in range(200)]
print("GET latency with idle server: median %.3f ms, max %.3f ms (200 samples)"%(sorted(base)[100], max(base)))
res={}
def run_keys():
    k=conn(); t=time.perf_counter(); k.sendall(b"*2\r\n$4\r\nKEYS\r\n$1\r\n*\r\n"); n=0
    while True:
        d=k.recv(1<<20); n+=len(d)
        if n>1000 and d.endswith(b"\r\n") and time.perf_counter()-t>0.01 and len(d)<(1<<20): 
            pass
        if n>=1000000*12: break
    res["keys_total_ms"]=(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000
th=threading.Thread(target=run_keys); th.start(); time.sleep(0.01)
during=[]; t0=time.perf_counter()
while th.is_alive() and time.perf_counter()-t0<10: during.append(get_lat(probe))
th.join(timeout=20)
print("while KEYS * running: probe GET max latency %.1f ms over %d probes (first probes stuck behind KEYS)"%(max(during),len(during)))
print("KEYS * client saw reply complete in %.0f ms"%res.get("keys_total_ms",-1))

import socket
def conn():
    s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",7206)); f=s.makefile("rb"); return s,f
def q(sf,*a):
    s,f=sf; s.sendall(b"*%d\r\n"%len(a)+b"".join(b"$%d\r\n%s\r\n"%(len(x),x.encode()) for x in a))
    l=f.readline().strip()
    if l[:1]==b"$":
        n=int(l[1:]); 
        if n>=0: f.read(n+2)
    return l.decode()
